thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane auth/orglookup error spike — 5xx increase in gateway. Threshold breached ~6m ago. Observed: 502/504, auth timeouts, org lookup 500s. See metrics: https://wavefront.redwood/graphs/CP-AUTH-5xx
sara: acked. I'm oncall for next 60m. Collecting traces.
devin: I'm pulling healthcheck logs from the auth cluster now. Running `kubectl logs -l app=controlplane-auth -n prod --tail=200`.
raj: getting alerts from edge-gateway too; some clients seeing 502s when auth calls hang.
sara: quick customer impact summary — several API clients experiencing request failures ~10% across regions eu-west and us-east. Logging indicates orglookup timeouts causing retries and queueing.
ops-bot: Automated mitigation recommended: enable fallback-route to auth-cache for non-critical reads. Triggered if error rate > 5%.
sara: let's not flip anything global yet. devin, can you confirm whether this is an upstream DB or networking? If DB, we'll scale read replicas. If network, we need routing changes.
devin: initial traces: auth pod outbound latencies to org-service increase sharply. `tcp_connect_time` shows spikes and SYN retransmits. Also seeing `502 gateway` in auth-proxy logs:
```
E 2026-03-15T12:07:23Z proxy.go:212 conn failed: dial tcp 10.34.12.9:8080: i/o timeout
```
raj: org service has a recent deploy ~35m ago. Rolling back might help.
sara: good catch. Devin, can you try routing a small percentage of auth traffic to the previous revision (canary rollback) via the control-plane router? Use canary=10%.
devin: doing: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/route -d '{"service":"org","target":"rev-2026-03-14","weight":10}'` — applied. Monitoring.
sara: ops-bot, start collecting error-rate by route.
ops-bot: Started. Route breakdown: rev-2026-03-15: error_rate=18% (p95 latency 1.9s). rev-2026-03-14: error_rate=2.1% (p95 120ms).
raj: rev-2026-03-15 is the culprit. Recent change in cache invalidation looks suspicious.
sara: escalate to eng-runtime. Devin/raj confirm rollback plan to 0% for rev-2026-03-15.
devin: rolling back now. `kubectl set image deployment/org service=org:rev-2026-03-14 -n prod` — rollout in progress.
sara: support-lead, prep customer comms: short note that we degraded routing for limited time while we investigate, ETA for full recovery unknown, will update every 30 min.
support-lead: prepping email + status page blurb. Notifying top-tier customers. Will post to status.redwood.com.
devin: rollout complete. New pods stable. ops-bot: error_rate now 1.8% and gateway 502s down to baseline.
sara: thanks. For postmortem: root cause likely cache invalidation bug in rev-2026-03-15 causing org service thrash under load. We forced canary rollback which mitigated impact. Next steps: capture heap/metrics on failing revision, add pre-deploy load test on org cache boundary, add circuit-breaker on control-plane routing to failover faster.
raj: also recommend temporary circuit-breaker to limit retries from gateway -> auth to reduce cascading failures (set retries=1, backoff=200ms).
ops-bot: Action items created: [INC-4412345678-1] rollback confirmed, [INC-4412345678-2] postmortem owner assigned (devin), [INC-4412345678-3] support comms (support-lead).
sara: handing this to devin for deeper debug, I'm staying available for 30m then hand to day team.
devin: taking ownership for postmortem and debug. I'll grab heap profiles and trace sampling for failing revision and open a PR to harden cache invalidation. Leaving oncall to sara in rotation. :thumbsup: 
sara: closing pager in 10m if metrics stable. thanks everyone.
support-lead: status page updated: https://status.redwood.com/incident/4412345678
ops-bot: Incident auto-log: created ticket INC-4412345678. Thread will remain open until postmortem published.
